seo.title: Schladming ski resort guide
seo.description: Four linked mountains above the Ennstal with 123 km of pistes, 50 lifts and 56 mountain huts, plus floodlit night skiing on the Hochwurzen.
seo.twitterDescription: Four mountains, 123 km of pistes and 50 lifts above the Ennstal.
seo.webpageDescription: Ski facts, where to stay and how to get to Schladming in Styria.

h1: Schladming ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Schladming sits at 738 metres in the Styrian Ennstal, under four mountains linked into one ski area: Planai above the town, Hochwurzen, Hauser Kaibling and Reiteralm. Together they hold 123 kilometres of pistes, 50 lifts and 56 mountain huts. The Hochwurzen adds floodlit night skiing and a seven kilometre toboggan run, the longest in the region.
stayOverview: The town sits at the foot of the Planai, with the cable car leaving from the edge of the centre. Rohrmoos and Pichl are spread along the valley towards Hochwurzen and Reiteralm, and Haus im Ennstal sits under Hauser Kaibling.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. Staying in Schladming puts you within walking distance of the Planai cable car; the other three mountains need the ski bus or a car.
rentalCars: Schladming is on the Ennstal road and the railway between Salzburg and Graz, about an hour and a half from Salzburg.

lifts.note: Serving the four-mountain link, with 56 ski huts on the mountains.

verticalDrop.unannounced: No vertical drop is published for the ski area on the operator's skiing, mountain or ticket pages.

topElevation.unannounced: The lift company's four-mountain, Planai and Hochwurzen pages give piste kilometres, lift counts and hut counts but no summit altitude, and its 2026/27 price pages give none either.

season.note: The resort's own 2026/27 ticket calendar. It prices an early and a late season either side of those dates but publishes no opening or closing day.

snowpark.unannounced: The Planai page mentions fun parks in passing but the operator names no terrain park and gives no count.

pistes.note: Across four linked mountains - Hauser Kaibling, Planai, Hochwurzen and Reiteralm - on one ski pass.

baseElevation.unannounced: The lift company's four-mountain, Planai and Hochwurzen pages give piste kilometres, lift counts and hut counts but no valley-station altitude, and its 2026/27 price pages give none either.

longestRun.unannounced: The region names the 4.6 km FIS downhill from the Planai summit to the valley and a 7 km toboggan run on the Hochwurzen, but does not say which piste is its longest.

dayPass.note: The ticket-office price for 2026/27. Booked online in advance the same ticket is EUR 69.50 to 81.50, and the early and late-season day ticket is EUR 76.00 at the window.

Four mountains - Planai, Hochwurzen, Hauser Kaibling and Reiteralm - are linked into 123 km of pistes served by 50 lifts.
